import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { NfcData } from '../../../core/models/nfc-data.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-chauffeur-nfc', templateUrl: './chauffeur-nfc.page.html' }) export class ChauffeurNfcPage implements OnInit { nfcData: NfcData | null = null; nfcSupported = false; status: 'idle' | 'writing' | 'success' | 'error' = 'idle'; errorMsg = ''; showPassword = false; currentStep = 1; steps = ['Données chargées', 'Approcher la carte', 'Écriture terminée']; constructor(private router: Router) {} ngOnInit(): void { const state = history.state; this.nfcData = state?.nfcData ?? null; this.nfcSupported = 'NDEFReader' in window; if (!this.nfcData) this.router.navigate(['/chauffeurs']); } async startWrite(): Promise { if (!this.nfcData) return; if (!this.nfcSupported) { this.status = 'error'; this.errorMsg = 'NFC non disponible sur cet appareil.'; return; } this.status = 'writing'; this.currentStep = 1; try { const ndef = new (window as any).NDEFReader(); await ndef.write({ records: [ { recordType: 'text', data: this.nfcData.record1 }, ...(this.nfcData.record2 ? [{ recordType: 'text', data: this.nfcData.record2 }] : []) ] }); this.status = 'success'; this.currentStep = 2; } catch (err: any) { this.status = 'error'; this.errorMsg = err?.message ?? 'Erreur lors de l\'écriture NFC.'; } } cancelWrite(): void { this.status = 'idle'; this.currentStep = 1; } reset(): void { this.status = 'idle'; this.currentStep = 1; } goBack(): void { this.router.navigate(['/chauffeurs']); } }
